sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: Fonderia Pellice (SUP-H) is approved for HB-620 only for the receiving site Pinerolo (PLT-PIN). The proposal is to deliver to Beinasco (PLT-BEI), and the ASL has no approval for that site. The ASL does cover HB-620, so this is a missing approval and not an unknown.

sources.quote: A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.
Moving production to another site is a change of source.

findings.why: HB-620 belongs to PRG-Y (Nordhavn). Moving supply to a different receiving site counts as a change of source under the Nordhavn requirements. It needs written Nordhavn approval before the first shipment. The documents contain no Nordhavn approval for Pellice to deliver to Beinasco.
